decision_zh: 可薄复用现有 InferRSI run_experiment 与已冻结两个 launcher/media helper；旧 rsi_pair_v2.py 不能直接套 persistent result。只需新的专用 adapter 改命令选择与结果抽取，不改 InferRSI 库或任何真实 controller。
why_not_direct: v2 require_selected_pair pins Trim8 vs Trim6.
v2 extract_metrics requires one POST and a top-level single artifact/history; persistent has two request records.
v2 selected profile/launcher/controller identity and cold-service scope are fixed; relabeling would be false evidence.
minimal_adapter: Reuse hash-bound source_snapshot and positive metric helpers, or small unchanged equivalents; new bundle contains both real controller/media/helper freezes and actual IR files, not fake Git commits.

Commands call existing offload-preparation/run_async_persistent_v1.py and headroom-preparation/run_headroom_persistent_v1.py with classic; each new service generates identical 424242/424243 sequence. Parent source verification must use actual filenames (confirm baseline helper spelling from filesystem before implementation).

Parse one dispatch/completed pair, enforce actual E run/R trial boundaries and source controller/gates expected for side. Require two accepted complete requests, no guard, one final owned cleanup and exact same recipe.

Invoke corresponding existing per-request media helper only after service reclaimed; validate both genuine reports, full MP4 SHA/bytes, actual graph and 8 uncached steps. Compare each seed with its previously established identical artifact SHA; never infer quality from latency.

Primary metric is actual native history duration of requests[1] (seed424243). First request is explicitly a priming request, retained and validated but excluded from the primary metric. Also keep both samplers, first history, total controller/outer, min whole-board free/private/RSS and media time separately.
run_experiment repetitions=2 provides order A B B A, four isolated services/eight total videos. Same two-seed warm policy per service; no previous single samples pooled into this repeated set.

Retain stop-file, fresh external resource admission each service, account>20% check from parent, deadline before each child and source snapshot before/after. Suggested bounded entire pair <=10 minutes; no automatic retries or parameter search.
Use validation_command=None and keep overall INCONCLUSIVE; descriptive medians and individual observations only. No newly invented latency or quality PASS threshold.
comparison_scope: same two-seed persistent-session warm second request; reused conditioning; excludes new-prompt TE/startup/asset hashing
necessary_small_checks: Pure tiny fake-result extraction rejects missing second request, cached sampler, graph/seed/artifact/media mismatch and unclean shutdown.
Source bundle drift and wrong side controller/media identity fail before dispatch.
Both real PPY help/preview entrypoints and final exact commands inspected; no GPU for preparation.

source_q33.lines: 30-46 single-result metric;48-68 true source snapshots;70-91 fixed pair/bundle;104-135 execute;141-148 RunSpec/evaluation

source_ir.lines: 69-82 repetitions=2 gives A B / B A;106-153 final source integrity/evaluation

scope_limit: This is a feasibility design only, not an implemented or ready adapter, and does not establish a stable headroom speed gain.
